- **Taskbar and Start Menu Customization**: The latest update reintroduced Windows 10-style taskbar and Start Menu customization options. This change is expected to roll out in the coming weeks for versions 24H2, 25H2, and 26H1.
  
- **Renaming of Recommendation Area**: The recommendation area has been renamed to "Recent," keeping newly installed apps visible and refining which files appear in that section. This update is also part of the ongoing rollout.

- **KB5089549 Update Issues**: There have been reports of installation issues with KB5089549, a recent update for Windows 11. However, Microsoft has provided a solution by allowing users to download this update via the official Media Creation Tool for USB installs.

These updates are part of the ongoing improvements and changes in Windows 11 as it continues to evolve based on user feedback and technological advancements.
